summary: Before archive, Harness now verifies that every attachment is indexed exactly once and INDEX stays within 120 lines, including ordinary evidence, knowledge and any closure file stored under attachments. The existing terminal boundary rejects defects before moving the Change. Inline-code, bare-path and Markdown-link bullets, plus first-column inline-code table entries, are accepted consistently with Protocol. This adds no user Gate or ordinary-status directory scan. Seven navigation defects across five existing archives were repaired without changing tasks, closure or evidence. Read-only guidance now uses change list for active Changes and reserves status for an exact Change. The preceding feedback-storage, isolated performance-probe and external-UBT admission fixes remain in place.
